recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7812 unless a future Pharmacy work-group task separately requests broad editorial cleanup of legacy v2 mapping punctuation.
issue_request: FHIR-7812 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for the DSTU1 MedicationPrescription v2 mapping. It asked to extend Reason[x] from ORC-16 Order Control Code Reason to also include RXE-27 Give Indication, and Jira comments requested adding the parallel RXO-20, RXD-21, RXG-22, and RXA-19 indication fields.
initial_application: Commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c explicitly listed tracker #7812 and changed the predecessor MedicationOrder.reason[x] v2 mapping from ORC-16 only to include RXE-27, RXO-20, RXD-21, RXG-22, and RXA-19. Later source migration carried the mapping into MedicationRequest, and a formatting commit preserved it.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest as an active resource, marks MedicationRequest approved, and notes that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml maps MedicationRequest.reason to ORC-16, RXE-27, RXO-20, RXD-21, RXG-22, and RXA-19. Jira searches found only FHIR-7812 for the RXE-27/Give Indication terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition already contains the requested mapping semantics.
